results.text:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build our analytics platform with React and TypeScript. You will own data visualisation features end to end, design APIs in Node.js, and work with ClickHouse. Requirements: 4+ years of experience building web applications, strong TypeScript, experience with data-heavy UIs. Location: Bangalore or remote within India. Benefits include health insurance and learning budget. [Apply](https://careers.good.example/apply) ![logo](https://x/logo.png)
